MERIDIAN SCENERY KIT — LAST VEHICLE 1.19
Original model geometry, palette and generator created for A GingrSnaps Project.

To the extent possible under law, the contributors dedicate the original art
and generator in this pack to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal.
You may use, modify and redistribute these assets, including commercially.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The kit was authored using numeric primitive geometry. It uses no external
models, textures, image-generation outputs or recordings. Babylon.js and Blender
are separate tools and retain their own licenses. The game code and GingrSnaps
branding retain the project's separate terms; this dedication covers the art
pack and its generator only.
